Spike detection: threshold crossings, Teager–Kaiser energy (NEO) and matched filtering on data
in memory, spatial de-duplication across neighbouring channels, and the streaming detector over a
whole recording ([`detect_recording`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/detection/#detect_recording), as `dspk detect`).

Detections are dicts of arrays sorted by time: `samples` (sample index), `channels`,
`amplitudes` (µV at the extremum).

| | |
|---|---|
| [`deduplicate`](#deduplicate) | One spike per event seen on several channels. |
| [`detect_recording`](#detect_recording) | Detects spikes over a whole [`Recording`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/io/#recording), read in place in `batch_s` batches (optional CAR, zero-phase band-pass, noise calibrated on spread-out chunks, crossings, spatial de-duplication, snippets, per-channel templates) as `dspk detect`; with `locate`, every spike located (centre of mass of its snippet's heights over its `k_neighbors`. |
| [`heights`](#heights) | Detection height per channel. |
| [`matched_filter`](#matched_filter) | Correlation with a spike shape (`prototype_`, default [`prototype`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/detection/#prototype) of `prototype_ms`) peaking beyond `threshold · σ(score)` where the signal is negative. |
| [`neo`](#neo) | Teager–Kaiser energy peaks beyond `threshold · σ(energy)` per channel. |
| [`prototype`](#prototype) | A zero-mean, unit-norm biphasic spike shape of `samples` samples. |
| [`threshold`](#threshold) | Local extrema beyond `threshold · σ` per channel of `data` `(channels, samples)` (`polarity`. |

## Functions

### `deduplicate`

```python
deduplicate(
    spikes: dict,
    probe: Probe,
    sample_rate: float,
    *,
    radius_um: float = DEFAULT_RADIUS_UM,
    window_ms: float = 0.5,
) -> dict
```

One spike per event seen on several channels: the largest within `radius_um` and
`window_ms` stays. Adds `participating` (the channels each event was seen on).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `spikes` | `dict` |  |
| `probe` | `Probe` |  |
| `sample_rate` | `float` |  |
| `radius_um` | `float` | `DEFAULT_RADIUS_UM` |
| `window_ms` | `float` | `0.5` |

### `detect_recording`

```python
detect_recording(
    recording,
    probe: Probe,
    *,
    band: tuple[float, float] = DEFAULT_BAND,
    car: bool = False,
    threshold: float = DEFAULT_RECORDING_THRESHOLD,
    refractory_ms: float = DEFAULT_REFRACTORY_MS,
    polarity: str = 'negative',
    spacing: str = 'locally_exclusive',
    radius_um: float = DEFAULT_RADIUS_UM,
    k_neighbors: int = DEFAULT_K_NEIGHBORS,
    pre_ms: float = DEFAULT_PRE_MS,
    post_ms: float = DEFAULT_POST_MS,
    sinc_shift: bool = True,
    locate: bool = True,
    batch_s: float = DEFAULT_BATCH_S,
    calibration_s: float = DEFAULT_CALIBRATION_S,
    calibration_chunks: int = DEFAULT_CALIBRATION_CHUNKS,
    runtime: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[Sorting, dict]
```

Detects spikes over a whole [`Recording`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/io/#recording), read in place in `batch_s` batches
(optional CAR, zero-phase band-pass, noise calibrated on spread-out chunks, crossings,
spatial de-duplication, snippets, per-channel templates) as `dspk detect`; with `locate`,
every spike located (centre of mass of its snippet's heights over its `k_neighbors`: the
sorting's `spikes()["locations"]`, else NaN). Returns a [`Sorting`](/dsp-kitchen/plugins/synapse/reference/python/io/#sorting) (one unit per
channel) and a summary (`sigmas_uv`, `raw_crossings`, `spikes`, `channel_counts`).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` |  |  |
| `probe` | `Probe` |  |
| `band` | `tuple[float, float]` | `DEFAULT_BAND` |
| `car` | `bool` | `False` |
| `threshold` | `float` | `DEFAULT_RECORDING_THRESHOLD` |
| `refractory_ms` | `float` | `DEFAULT_REFRACTORY_MS` |
| `polarity` | `str` | `'negative'` |
| `spacing` | `str` | `'locally_exclusive'` |
| `radius_um` | `float` | `DEFAULT_RADIUS_UM` |
| `k_neighbors` | `int` | `DEFAULT_K_NEIGHBORS` |
| `pre_ms` | `float` | `DEFAULT_PRE_MS` |
| `post_ms` | `float` | `DEFAULT_POST_MS` |
| `sinc_shift` | `bool` | `True` |
| `locate` | `bool` | `True` |
| `batch_s` | `float` | `DEFAULT_BATCH_S` |
| `calibration_s` | `float` | `DEFAULT_CALIBRATION_S` |
| `calibration_chunks` | `int` | `DEFAULT_CALIBRATION_CHUNKS` |
| `runtime` | `str \| None` | `None` |

### `threshold`

```python
threshold(
    data,
    sample_rate: float,
    *,
    threshold: float = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
    polarity: str = 'negative',
    refractory_ms: float = DEFAULT_REFRACTORY_MS,
    sigmas=None,
    spacing: str = 'locally_exclusive',
) -> dict
```

Local extrema beyond `threshold · σ` per channel of `data` `(channels, samples)`
(`polarity`: negative, positive, both). `sigmas`: each channel's noise (default: estimated,
median-based). Spikes on a channel stay more than `refractory_ms` apart (`spacing`:
`locally_exclusive`, which chunked detection reproduces exactly, or `scipy`).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `data` |  |  |
| `sample_rate` | `float` |  |
| `threshold` | `float` | `DEFAULT_THRESHOLD` |
| `polarity` | `str` | `'negative'` |
| `refractory_ms` | `float` | `DEFAULT_REFRACTORY_MS` |
| `sigmas` |  | `None` |
| `spacing` | `str` | `'locally_exclusive'` |
